import gleam/float
import gleam/int
import gleam/list
import gleam/option.{type Option, None, Some}
import simplifina/matrix.{type Matrix, from_rows, get, map, rows, shape}
import simplifina/vector.{type Vector, dot, norm}
import gleam/result
import gleam/erlang/process
import gleam/otp/actor

// --- KAN Spline Activation & Grid Update Logic ---

// B-spline basis function of order k
fn b_spline_basis(x: Float, i: Int, k: Int, knots: Vector(Float)) -> Float {
  let n = vector.length(knots) - 1
  assert k >= 0
  assert i >= 0
  assert i < n - k

  case k {
    0 -> {
      let t_i = vector.at(knots, i) |> result.unwrap(0.0)
      let t_i1 = vector.at(knots, i + 1) |> result.unwrap(0.0)
      case x >= t_i && x < t_i1 {
        True -> 1.0
        False -> 0.0
      }
    }
    _ -> {
      let t_i = vector.at(knots, i) |> result.unwrap(0.0)
      let t_ik = vector.at(knots, i + k) |> result.unwrap(0.0)
      let t_i1 = vector.at(knots, i + 1) |> result.unwrap(0.0)
      let t_ik1 = vector.at(knots, i + k + 1) |> result.unwrap(0.0)

      let term1 = {
        let denominator = t_ik - t_i
        case denominator == 0.0 {
          True -> 0.0
          False -> (x - t_i) /. denominator *. b_spline_basis(x, i, k - 1, knots)
        }
      }

      let term2 = {
        let denominator = t_ik1 - t_i1
        case denominator == 0.0 {
          True -> 0.0
          False ->
            (t_ik1 - x) /. denominator *. b_spline_basis(x, i + 1, k - 1, knots)
        }
      }

      term1 +. term2
    }
  }
}

// The KAN activation function for a single neuron
fn kan_activation(x: Float, coeffs: Vector(Float), knots: Vector(Float), spline_order: Int) -> Float {
  let basis_values =
    list.range(0, vector.length(coeffs) - 1)
    |> list.map(fn(i) { b_spline_basis(x, i, spline_order, knots) })
    |> vector.from_list

  dot(coeffs, basis_values) |> result.unwrap(0.0)
}


// --- Adaptive Grid Logic based on Input Statistics ---

pub type GridUpdateMetrics {
  GridUpdateMetrics(
    variance: Float,
    entropy: Float,
    spectral_norm: Float,
  )
}

fn calculate_shannon_entropy(data: Vector(Float)) -> Float {
  let total_count = int.to_float(vector.length(data))
  // Simplified histogram for entropy calc
  let counts =
    data
    |> vector.to_list
    |> list.group(fn(a, b) { float.compare(a, b) == Equal })
    |> list.map(fn(group) { int.to_float(list.length(group)) })

  counts
  |> list.fold(0.0, fn(acc, count) {
    let p = count /. total_count
    case p > 0.0 {
      True -> acc -. p *. float.log(p)
      False -> acc
    }
  })
}

// Proposes a new grid based on the quantiles of the input distribution
fn propose_new_grid(
  inputs: Vector(Float),
  grid_size: Int,
  current_knots: Vector(Float),
) -> Vector(Float) {
  let sorted_inputs = vector.sort(inputs, float.compare)
  let n = vector.length(sorted_inputs)

  let quantiles =
    list.range(0, grid_size)
    |> list.map(fn(i) {
      let rank = float.from_int(i) /. float.from_int(grid_size) *. float.from_int(n)
      let index = float.round(rank)
      vector.at(sorted_inputs, index) |> result.unwrap(0.0)
    })

  // Merge with existing knots to prevent drastic shifts (e.g., using a moving average)
  let alpha = 0.1 // Update rate
  vector.zip(vector.from_list(quantiles), current_knots)
  |> result.map(fn(pairs) {
    pairs
    |> list.map(fn(pair) { alpha *. pair.0 +. (1.0 -. alpha) *. pair.1 })
    |> vector.from_list
  })
  |> result.unwrap(current_knots)
}


// --- The Adaptive KAN Layer Actor ---

pub type State {
  State(
    in_dim: Int,
    out_dim: Int,
    spline_order: Int,
    grid_size: Int,
    // Matrix where each element is a vector of spline coefficients
    spline_coeffs: Matrix(Vector(Float)),
    // Matrix where each element is a vector of knot points
    knot_grids: Matrix(Vector(Float)),
    // Buffer for recent inputs to calculate statistics
    input_buffer: list.List(Vector(Float)),
    buffer_capacity: Int,
    update_threshold: Float,
  )
}

pub type Msg {
  Forward(Vector(Float))
  UpdateMetrics(GridUpdateMetrics)
  GetWeights
}

pub type Response {
  ForwardResponse(Vector(Float))
  UpdateComplete
  WeightsResponse(Matrix(Vector(Float)))
}

fn handle_cast(msg: Msg, state: State) -> actor.Next(State) {
  case msg {
    UpdateMetrics(metrics) -> {
      let should_update =
        metrics.variance > state.update_threshold || metrics.entropy > state.update_threshold

      case should_update {
        False -> actor.continue(state)
        True -> {
          // Flatten buffer to get distribution for each input dimension
          let inputs_by_dim =
            list.range(0, state.in_dim - 1)
            |> list.map(fn(i) {
              state.input_buffer
              |> list.map(fn(inp) { vector.at(inp, i) |> result.unwrap(0.0) })
              |> vector.from_list
            })

          let new_knot_grids =
            list.range(0, state.out_dim - 1)
            |> list.map(fn(j) {
              list.range(0, state.in_dim - 1)
              |> list.map(fn(i) {
                let current_grid =
                  matrix.get(state.knot_grids, j, i)
                  |> result.unwrap(vector.new())
                propose_new_grid(
                  list.at(inputs_by_dim, i) |> result.unwrap(vector.new()),
                  state.grid_size,
                  current_grid,
                )
              })
              |> vector.from_list
            })
            |> matrix.from_rows
            |> result.unwrap(state.knot_grids)

          actor.continue(State(..state, knot_grids: new_knot_grids))
        }
      }
    }
    // Other casts would be handled here
    _ -> actor.continue(state)
  }
}

fn handle_call(msg: Msg, _from, state: State) -> actor.Next(State) {
  case msg {
    Forward(input) -> {
      let output =
        list.range(0, state.out_dim - 1)
        |> list.map(fn(j) {
          list.range(0, state.in_dim - 1)
          |> list.map(fn(i) {
            let x_i = vector.at(input, i) |> result.unwrap(0.0)
            let coeffs =
              matrix.get(state.spline_coeffs, j, i)
              |> result.unwrap(vector.new())
            let knots =
              matrix.get(state.knot_grids, j, i)
              |> result.unwrap(vector.new())
            kan_activation(x_i, coeffs, knots, state.spline_order)
          })
          |> float.sum
        })
        |> vector.from_list

      // Update input buffer
      let new_buffer = [input, ..state.input_buffer]
      let trimmed_buffer =
        case list.length(new_buffer) > state.buffer_capacity {
          True -> list.take(new_buffer, state.buffer_capacity)
          False -> new_buffer
        }

      actor.reply(
        ForwardResponse(output),
        State(..state, input_buffer: trimmed_buffer),
      )

// Represents a complex number in fixed-point representation
case class ComplexFix(realWidth: Int, imagWidth: Int) extends Bundle {
  val real = SFix(realWidth exp, -realWidth exp)
  val imag = SFix(imagWidth exp, -imagWidth exp)

  def +(that: ComplexFix): ComplexFix = {
    val result = ComplexFix(realWidth, imagWidth)
    result.real := this.real + that.real
    result.imag := this.imag + that.imag
    result
  }

  def *(that: ComplexFix): ComplexFix = {
    val result = ComplexFix(realWidth, imagWidth)
    // (a+bi)(c+di) = (ac-bd) + (ad+bc)i
    result.real := this.real * that.real - this.imag * that.imag
    result.imag := this.real * that.imag + this.imag * that.real
    result
  }
}
